title: Miért nemzeti ünnep március 15.? (Why March 15 Is a National Holiday)
grammar: Adverbial Participles, Rhetorical Imperatives & National Symbols Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say why 15 March is a national holiday.
I can say how 15 March is marked: ceremonies, wreath-laying, cockades.
I can say what the citizenship oath is.
I can use six new words about the national holiday, such as koszorúzás and megemlékezés.
